Ranked: 1 route row says where its money lands (ui-programmer, S); 2 idle stock shows its next step after the buy/send split (ui-programmer, S); 3 a full lane offers a route upgrade instead of one more ship (gameplay-programmer, M; numbers from economy-designer); 4 the Expansion branch changes something before system 3 (gameplay-programmer, M); 5 stranded rule matches the new economy (gameplay-programmer, S).
